study.question: Can source-gradient arithmetic alone change the global auxiliary orientation bit and click AUC? The latest fixed-common and pooled-common positive-label controls should be positive scalar equivalents at a common state when pooled prevalence is positive, but their reversed-sign AUCs differ by0.000263758. Before treating that difference as auxiliary label information, test an algebraically equivalent, better-conditioned source expression at the same constant target.
study.hypothesis: At the inherited fixed-common source target a=1/256, BCE(a)-BCE(0) and a*(BCE(1)-BCE(0)) have the same ideal derivative. The inherited expression can subtract nearby probability cotangents; the factored expression subtracts opposite-sign endpoint cotangents. Finite-precision source differences may flip the maximal-coordinate orientation bit and alter subsequent training. This is an unverified implementation-level explanation, not evidence that task supervision is unnecessary. The candidate tests arithmetic at a fixed semantic source and fixed native geometry.

study.proposed_difference: Add source_gradient_arithmetic in {difference,factored}. Build the original BCE(1/256)-BCE(0) source exactly as before and the new (BCE(1)-BCE(0))/256 source through the same recipient probabilities. Always evaluate both autograd.grad calls to edges[1:4], retain the graph, and select one detached triple for the inherited zero-value surrogate on edges[4:7]. Four standalone cells cross this single arithmetic replacement with aligned/reversed external sign. No new learned state, forward pass, RNG, loss weighting, optimizer setting, logit reconstruction or hand-coded BCE denominator.
predictions: At a common initialization/state, all four probability outputs, true-label returned scalar, running-buffer updates, and native/private gradients agree; the source arithmetic can affect only the source-bit injection.

The ideal source VJPs coincide at constant1/256. A same-state host probe may find nonzero numerical residuals and occasional bit disagreements, concentrated near pivot ties or degenerate tangent gates. This is a hypothesis; scalar emulation is not tensor evidence.

At common state, aligned and reversed external signs use the same native transfer line/radius and opposite transfers, while retaining identical click cotangent; post-cast differences and zero transfers must be reported.
The two difference bridges reproduce corresponding round75 fixed-common AUCs within1e-6. Without bridge parity, interpret neither candidate changes nor sign interactions.
If bit disagreements arise and alter click ranking, the effect of factorization may depend on external sign. There is no predeclared claim that either factorized sign improves AUC.
falsifiers: If authorized common-state probes show no bit or context-VJP disagreement across representative batches and paired training trajectories/metrics agree within repeatability, the proposed consequential arithmetic explanation is unsupported.

If factorization alters forward predictions, returned true loss, native geometry or private gradients at fixed state, the implementation fails isolation and must be corrected before scientific interpretation.
A failed difference-bridge replay invalidates historical comparisons; it is an execution/implementation discrepancy, not evidence for a new mechanism.

If source residuals occur without bit disagreement, they cannot directly explain a different injected direction at that common state. Conversely, AUC differences without same-state diagnostics establish only an arithmetic intervention effect, not cancellation as its cause.

No useful auxiliary-supervision claim can be established from this constant-source test alone: true-label geometry/private supervision remain, and independent paired seeds/holdout assessment are absent.
alternative_explanations: FP32/BF16 casts and reduction order remain part of the implementation; factorization is not exact-arithmetic tensor execution.
A discontinuous global argmax orientation can amplify tiny source differences; ties and inherited tangent degeneracy must be retained.
The fixed-common source retains true-label private updates, native radius and exclusion geometry; this is not a label-free model.
A single seed and reused validation selection do not establish statistical significance or generalization.
Optional same-state probes are not automatically collected by the exposed host interface. Performance alone cannot identify where numerical discrepancies arise.
The motivating pooled source can be exactly zero on a batch, whereas1/256 is always positive. This study removes that semantic/zero-batch difference rather than assuming it absent.
Different positive scalars can change finite-precision operations even without nearby subtraction; endpoint factorization does not isolate every casting and reduction effect.
Repeated-ID sparse accumulation, adaptive updates and shared normalization can amplify a rare bit change; pre-scatter row geometry is not parameter-space orthogonality.
